name: Dictionary API
label: Merriam-Webster Collegiate Dictionary
description: Official Merriam-Webster Collegiate Dictionary JSON API v3. define only (no random endpoint exists). Query key. Free MW is non-commercial ≤1000/day; commercial needs a licence and logo. dictionaryapi.dev is not wired (community, unofficial relative to a publisher; OfficialApiNode is single-host).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for Dictionary API. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"define"}.

schema.label: word
schema.description: Headword to look up. Path {word}. Example: ubiquitous.

schema.label: ref
schema.description: Merriam-Webster reference set. EXACT: collegiate | intermediate | learners | spanish | medical | collegiate-thesaurus | schdil. Default collegiate.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: ref
configurationParameters.description: Default dictionary when INPUT ref is empty.

configurationParameters.label: Word
configurationParameters.description: Headword to look up. Path {word}. Example: ubiquitous.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.
